fields.c2Domains: Known command-and-control domains used by malware to exfiltrate data or receive instructions.
fields.maliciousNpmPackages: npm packages confirmed to be malicious or supply-chain-compromised. Name-only detection — the entire package is flagged regardless of version.
fields.maliciousPypiPackages: PyPI packages confirmed to be malicious or supply-chain-compromised. Name-only detection.
fields.compromisedVersions: Version-scoped entries — only specific version ranges are flagged. Use when earlier/later releases of a package are safe (e.g. a hijacked patch release). Each entry: { name, versions[], safeVersion, campaign, ref }.
